answer.book: A 1656 Marburg printing of Cyriacus Lentulus's Censura of authors for civil prudence, built as a title page, a dedication to Justus Henricus Heidfeld, and one continuous dissertation, 'De autoribus legendis', whose running heads name the authors discussed.

entries.title: Amplissimo & consultissimo viro DN. Justo Henrico Heidfeldio, Illustrissimus Nassovia Principibus ab Imperii & juris dic
